rationale.reason: The delivered non-elevated roads and expressly included crossings/safety works match; elevated highways and tunnels remain separate leaves.

reviewed_boundary.scope:
1. Scope and Applicability

This PCR describes the actual construction and acceptance handover of a geographically identified complete non-elevated highway, street, road, surfaced parking area, driveway, pedestrian walkway or bicycle path, including its declared drainage, shoulders, safety installations and vehicular/pedestrian underpasses or overpasses. It describes a physical civil-engineering entity, not a construction service or a bundle of materials. The classification distinction and crossings are grounded in `un-cpc3-constructions-2025` (pp. 277–279). Pure pavement maintenance is not a substitute for this complete delivery.

Exclude elevated highways, standalone bridges/viaducts, highway tunnels, railway roadbeds and airfield runways, material/equipment manufacturing and separately sold construction services. Resolve ambiguity between an integral road crossing and a separately delivered bridge with the actual asset register and owner boundary before applying this PCR; do not silently delete the crossing. Construction data cover only the declared initial project through acceptance. Traffic use, operational lighting, later maintenance/renewal and eventual demolition are separate stages and are not assigned an invented schedule or lifespan.
reviewed_boundary.covered: Non-elevated road entities and the officially included paths, parking and road-safety/crossing installations, as one declared accepted work
reviewed_boundary.excluded: Elevated highways; standalone bridges; highway tunnels; railways; runways; upstream materials; equipment; construction services
reviewed_boundary.market_state: Installed physical entity accepted at site; not a mass-normalized material or equipment output

unresolved_flow_identities.reason: Selected suitable imported mineral soil needs source and moisture/acceptance identity. Excavated-soil/remediation candidates do not establish uncontaminated road embankment suitability. Blank identity is not a claim of database absence.

Non-hazardous surplus mineral soil kept specific. Generic muck contains soil/material/other wastes and at-plant mix; site-remediation soil cannot establish this waste identity. Blank identity is not a claim of database absence.

Road-base crushed stone requires actual grading/state. Available 16/32 crushed stone cannot represent all gradings; railway ballast and soil-remediation volume gravel are route-specific. No false grade default is introduced. Blank identity is not a claim of database absence.

Industrial European hydration powder, flash-smelting-route lime and elementary calcium hydroxide do not establish unrestricted road-treatment supplied hydrated lime across actual sources/states. Blank identity is not a claim of database absence.

Public polypropylene textile describes a South Korean remediation biopile case. Area reference property could be preserved with real areal-mass conversion; route mismatch, not area alone, blocks adopting that identity. Blank identity is not a claim of database absence.
Natural/oxidised asphalt and waterproofing membrane do not establish cationic tack-coat emulsion wet formulation. Blank identity is not a claim of database absence.

Excavated asphalt candidate is from contaminated-site excavation; asphalt residue is upstream production. Neither establishes uncontaminated new-work asphalt mixture waste. Blank identity is not a claim of database absence.

Cast-In-Place Concrete describes onsite poured/cured concrete, and generic Concrete includes cement or asphalt binder and hardened state. Neither establishes delivered fresh ready-mixed concrete at the stated input boundary. Blank identity is not a claim of database absence.
Generic Sealant/Caulk Compound does not establish silicone road-joint formulation/state. Blank identity is not a claim of database absence.
Sawn timber candidates need species/moisture and usable formwork state; a pallet or generic lumber row is not automatically this reusable board. Blank identity is not a claim of database absence.
Mixed construction waste and recovered aggregate do not establish separately characterized uncontaminated hardened concrete rubble. Blank identity is not a claim of database absence.

Wastewater candidate d2d44ce1-c0f4-461d-9413-f4b33e0d200f has electrolytic-manganese-residue washing route. No verified alkaline concrete-washout treatment-bound identity adopted. Blank identity is not a claim of database absence.
Generic wet/mixed waste and wastewater are not separately measured settled concrete-washout sludge. Blank identity is not a claim of database absence.
Available concrete-pavement-brick cut/extruded billets or mixing intermediates are not an accepted precast paving block. Blank identity is not a claim of database absence.

Granite slab candidate inspected; no verified paving configuration/finish property and delivery applicability adopted. Countertop description alone cannot establish pavement suitability. Blank identity is not a claim of database absence.
Plastic pipes, seamless steel pipe and PRB trench gates are not precast reinforced concrete drainage pipe. Blank identity is not a claim of database absence.
Galvanized frame/sheet or generic galvanizing does not establish configured crash/safety guardrail assembly with posts and fixings. Blank identity is not a claim of database absence.
Available painted frame identity is a finished machinery component; no verified waterborne acrylic road-marking formulation adopted. Blank identity is not a claim of database absence.
Glass Bead direct record describes abrasive/blasting beads. Road-marking retroreflective grade remains unestablished. Blank identity is not a claim of database absence.

Dewatering effluent to a treatment recipient needs actual liquid characterization and route; generic direct-to-water wastewater identity is not this technosphere transfer. Blank identity is not a claim of database absence.

Excavated-soil Belgium transport is case-limited; unspecified lorry candidate has Mass rather than mass-distance and inconsistent refrigerator classification. No generic non-refrigerated kg*km service forced. Blank identity is not a claim of database absence.

Whole accepted road entity with its actual ancillary scope is not established by available Road/Forest road identities. Road has Length property and an at-plant construction-access description; neither count/geometry conversion nor naming establishes the whole scope. Preserve blank UUID pending semantic identity review. Blank identity is not a claim of database absence.

boundary_limitations: Initial construction and handover only; no default lifespan or complete cradle-to-gate/full-life claim.
Further actual routes/components need specific added exchanges before dataset completeness claim.
FP-24 evidence read from official PDF through web extraction; local download was blocked. Its contractual tolerances and equipment prescriptions are not generalized.
unresolved_evidence: Actual project geometry, material quantities, energy/water, emission speciation/factors, acceptance and conserved reuse ledger must be collected during dataset production.
Noise, work-zone effects, land-use and later lifecycle stages are not quantified by this construction inventory.
